request: Open Calculator.
setup: Focus the task-workspace folder in Finder.

request: Open Calendar and leave its main calendar window in front.
setup: Focus the task-workspace folder in Finder.

request: Open the Sound pane in System Settings.
setup: Focus the task-workspace folder in Finder.

request: Open Keyboard settings.
setup: Focus the task-workspace folder in Finder.

request: Switch from Keyboard settings to Displays.
setup: Leave the Keyboard pane open in System Settings.

request: Create a new local note whose first line is Clicky project review.
setup: Use a disposable local Notes folder. Focus the task-workspace folder in Finder.

request: In this note, add the line Check the release checklist.
setup: Create a disposable note named Release handoff with an empty body, then focus it.

request: Switch to the Safari tab titled Example Domain.
setup: In Safari open https://example.org and https://www.apple.com in two tabs of the same window. Focus the Apple tab.

request: Open https://example.org in Safari.
setup: Set Safari as the default browser for this case, then focus the task-workspace folder in Finder.

request: Switch to the Chrome tab titled Example Domain.
setup: In Chrome open https://example.org and https://www.apple.com in adjacent tabs. Focus the Apple tab.

request: Open the text file Clicky-source.txt in TextEdit from this folder.
setup: Set TextEdit as the default handler for this disposable .txt file. Focus the task-workspace folder in Finder.

request: Rename the file Clicky-rename.txt to Clicky-reviewed.txt in this folder.
setup: Start with Clicky-rename.txt present and Clicky-reviewed.txt absent. Keep Finder in front.

request: Duplicate Clicky-copy.txt in this folder and name the copy Clicky-backup.txt.
setup: Confirm Clicky-copy.txt exists and Clicky-backup.txt is absent. Leave Finder in front.

request: Create a folder called Clicky exports inside this Finder window.
setup: Ensure Clicky exports is absent and leave the task-workspace folder in front.

request: Add the line Ready for review to this disposable TextEdit document.
setup: Open Clicky-edit.txt in TextEdit and place the insertion point at the beginning.

request: Compose a mail draft with the subject Clicky review request and leave it open.
setup: Choose Mail as the default mail app. Focus the task-workspace folder in Finder.

request: Open the Clicky material subfolder in this Finder window.
setup: Focus the task-workspace folder in Finder.

request: Go up to the parent folder in Finder.
setup: Open the Clicky material subfolder and keep Finder in front.

request: Show the Get Info window for Clicky-source.txt.
setup: Select Clicky-source.txt in the task-workspace Finder window.

request: Use a terminal command to make an empty file named Clicky-terminal.txt in {workspace}.
setup: Ensure Clicky-terminal.txt is absent. Focus the task-workspace Finder window.
